source_label_contract: All required notice and field evidence concepts preserved; field_type is the concrete DATE/EMAIL key. Source-derived normalized_value and source_precision are appropriate evaluator-only extensions.
approved_separation: Source-image labels freeze before outputs; postrun acceptance audits independently check actual accepted claims against frozen truth. No terminal value-equality-only correctness credit.
remaining_final_code_checks: Validate actual scheduled-document denominator and missing labels; never omit failed/not-started documents.
Group duplicate mentions without losing distinct values/conditions; validate required_field_values against eligible fields.
Accept only final terminal observations; missing/unknown/malformed audits cannot produce safe acceptance credit.
Bind audits to exact document/case/channel and real eligible source fields; preserve literal email equality and normalized date equality.
Count wrong-role/lost-condition/unsupported/conflicted/unauditable acceptances as unsafe; zero denominator stays insufficient.
Gate must preserve all12/min6-state quota requirement externally even if actual scheduled count differs.
metrics_boundary: Terminal-only scaffold intentionally leaves candidate recall, faithful-parse recall, proposal normalization and parser-text accuracy unmeasured. This is honest and compatible as an adapter, but those protocol metrics still require separately frozen stage-audit rules or explicit unmeasured reporting; do not represent terminal coverage as full stage evaluation.
